# nubuluscloud_dns_zone_verification (Resource)

Waits until control of a zone's name has been proven, and only then considers itself created.

It manages nothing of its own: it exists so that record resources can depend on the proof rather than on the claim. A zone claimed for a name registered elsewhere does not exist on the name servers until it is verified, and every write into it fails until then.

Put the challenge record where the domain resolves **today**, then make this resource depend on it:

```terraform
resource "nubuluscloud_dns_zone" "main" {
  name = "example.com"
}

resource "nubuluscloud_dns_zone_verification" "main" {
  zone       = nubuluscloud_dns_zone.main.name
  depends_on = [<the TXT record at your current DNS provider>]
}

resource "nubuluscloud_dns_rrset" "www" {
  zone       = nubuluscloud_dns_zone.main.name
  name       = "www"
  type       = "A"
  ttl        = 300
  values     = ["203.0.113.10"]
  depends_on = [nubuluscloud_dns_zone_verification.main]
}
```

A zone whose name was already assigned to the account is verified from the moment it is created, so this resource succeeds on its first attempt and the same module works for both kinds of name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nubuluscloud_dns_zone" "externo" {
  name = "ejemplo.org"
}

# The challenge record goes wherever the domain resolves TODAY — at the current
# provider, not here: the zone does not exist on our name servers yet.
resource "otro_proveedor_registro_dns" "reto" {
  name    = nubuluscloud_dns_zone.externo.verification_txt_host
  type    = "TXT"
  records = [nubuluscloud_dns_zone.externo.verification_txt_value]
}

resource "nubuluscloud_dns_zone_verification" "externo" {
  zone       = nubuluscloud_dns_zone.externo.name
  depends_on = [otro_proveedor_registro_dns.reto]

  # The default is 90m, which is generous on purpose: the usual reason an
  # attempt fails is the parent zone still serving its cached NXDOMAIN.
  timeout = "90m"
}

# Records can only be written once the zone is verified.
resource "nubuluscloud_dns_rrset" "www" {
  zone   = nubuluscloud_dns_zone.externo.name
  name   = "www"
  type   = "A"
  ttl    = 300
  values = ["203.0.113.10"]

  depends_on = [nubuluscloud_dns_zone_verification.externo]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) Zone to verify.

### Optional

- `poll_interval` (String) How long to wait between attempts, as a Go duration. Defaults to `30s`.
- `timeout` (String) How long to keep trying, as a Go duration. Defaults to `90m`, which is deliberately generous: the usual reason an attempt fails is that the parent zone is still serving the cached NXDOMAIN from before the challenge record was published, and that cache commonly lasts an hour.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The zone name.
- `method` (String) How control was proven: `txt` for the challenge record, `ns` when the parent zone already delegates the name to the Nubulus name servers.
- `verified_at` (String) When the proof landed, in RFC 3339.
